papers.title: A new graph-based surrogate model for rapid prediction of crashworthiness performance of vehicle panel components
papers.abstract: During the design cycle of safety critical vehicle components such as B-pillars, crashworthiness performance is a key metric for passenger protection assessment in vehicle accidents. Traditional finite element simulations for crashworthiness analysis involve complex modelling, leading to an increased computational demand. Although a few machine learning-based surrogate models have been developed for rapid predictions for crashworthiness analysis, they exhibit limitations in detailed representation of complex 3D components. Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as a promising solution for processing data with complex structures. However, existing GNN models often lack sufficient accuracy and computational efficiency to meet industrial demands. This paper proposes Recurrent Graph U-Net (ReGUNet), a new graph-based surrogate model for crashworthiness analysis of vehicle panel components. ReGUNet adoptes a U-Net architecture with multiple graph downsampling and upsampling layers, which improves the model's computational efficiency and accuracy; the introduction of recurrence enhances the accuracy and stability of temporal predictions over multiple time steps. ReGUNet is evaluated through a case study of side crash testing of a B-pillar component with variation in geometric design. The trained model demonstrates great accuracy in predicting the dynamic behaviour of previously unseen component designs within a relative error of 0.74% for the maximum B-pillar intrusion. Compared to the baseline models, ReGUNet can reduce the averaged mean prediction error of the component's deformation by more than 51% with significant improvement in computational efficiency. Provided enhanced accuracy and efficiency, ReGUNet shows greater potential in accurate predictions of large and complex graphs compared to existing models.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的图神经网络代理模型方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但缺乏不确定性量化和约束处理。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address uncertainty quantification, constraint handling, or biomedical implant design context.

summary_zh.validation: 通过侧碰撞案例验证，对比基线模型评估精度和效率。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of crashworthiness finite element simulations for vehicle panel components.
summary_en.method: Proposes ReGUNet, a graph-based surrogate model combining U-Net architecture with recurrent layers for temporal prediction.
summary_en.result: Achieves 0.74% relative error for maximum B-pillar intrusion and reduces average deformation prediction error by over 51%.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a side crash test case of a B-pillar component with geometric variations.

papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification for Data-Driven Machine Learning Models in Nuclear Engineering Applications: Where We Are and What Do We Need?
papers.abstract: Machine learning (ML) has been leveraged to tackle a diverse range of tasks in almost all branches of nuclear engineering. Many of the successes in ML applications can be attributed to the recent performance breakthroughs in deep learning, the growing availability of computational power, data, and easy-to-use ML libraries. However, these empirical successes have often outpaced our formal understanding of the ML algorithms. An important but under-rated area is uncertainty quantification (UQ) of ML. ML-based models are subject to approximation uncertainty when they are used to make predictions, due to sources including but not limited to, data noise, data coverage, extrapolation, imperfect model architecture and the stochastic training process. The goal of this paper is to clearly explain and illustrate the importance of UQ of ML. We will elucidate the differences in the basic concepts of UQ of physics-based models and data-driven ML models. Various sources of uncertainties in physical modeling and data-driven modeling will be discussed, demonstrated, and compared. We will also present and demonstrate a few techniques to quantify the ML prediction uncertainties. Finally, we will discuss the need for building a verification, validation and UQ framework to establish ML credibility.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文讨论了机器学习不确定性量化的一般框架，但未涉及FEA代理模型或生物力学设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on nuclear engineering applications and does not address surrogate modeling for FEA, implant design, or biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 机器学习在核工程中广泛应用，但不确定性量化不足。
summary_zh.method: 综述了物理模型与数据驱动模型UQ的概念、来源和技术。
summary_zh.result: 强调了建立验证、确认和UQ框架对ML可信度的重要性。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为综述性讨论。

summary_en.motivation: The widespread adoption of ML in nuclear engineering lacks adequate uncertainty quantification, which is critical for model credibility.
summary_en.method: This review compares UQ concepts for physics-based and data-driven models, discusses uncertainty sources, and demonstrates several UQ techniques.
summary_en.result: It advocates for a verification, validation, and UQ framework to establish ML credibility in safety-critical applications.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the paper is a conceptual review with illustrative examples.

papers.title: Density-Functional Theory and Triply-Periodic Minimal Surfaces
papers.abstract: Several authors have suggested that the surfaces of vanishing potential generated by the electrostatic fields from a distribution of point charges resemble triply periodic minimal surfaces (TPMS) corresponding to the positions of the point charges. We provide a theoretical basis for this phenomenological comparison by starting with the Boltzmann equation to show that the surface corresponding to zero charge density is a minimal surface. We then use density-functional calculations for elemental materials that differ electronically and structurally, Na, Cu, and Al, to show that surfaces of vanishing charge density converge to the corresponding TPMS.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文与AM生物医学材料方向无关，未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡、LPBF制造或力学测试。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a theoretical DFT study on TPMS and charge density, with no LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing, fatigue, or biomedical context.

summary_zh.result: 零电荷密度面收敛于对应的三周期极小曲面
summary_zh.validation: 理论推导与DFT数值计算验证

summary_en.motivation: To provide a theoretical basis for the observed resemblance between zero-potential surfaces from point charges and triply periodic minimal surfaces.
summary_en.method: Derivation from the Boltzmann equation and density-functional calculations for Na, Cu, and Al to show that zero charge density surfaces are minimal surfaces.
summary_en.result: Surfaces of vanishing charge density converge to the corresponding triply periodic minimal surfaces.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical derivation and DFT numerical calculations.

papers.title: Decision by Supervised Learning with Deep Ensembles: A Practical Framework for Robust Portfolio Optimization
papers.abstract: We propose Decision by Supervised Learning (DSL), a practical framework for robust portfolio optimization. DSL reframes portfolio construction as a supervised learning problem: models are trained to predict optimal portfolio weights, using cross-entropy loss and portfolios constructed by maximizing the Sharpe or Sortino ratio. To further enhance stability and reliability, DSL employs Deep Ensemble methods, substantially reducing variance in portfolio allocations. Through comprehensive backtesting across diverse market universes and neural architectures, shows superior performance compared to both traditional strategies and leading machine learning-based methods, including Prediction-Focused Learning and End-to-End Learning. We show that increasing the ensemble size leads to higher median returns and more stable risk-adjusted performance. The code is available at https://github.com/DSLwDE/DSLwDE.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究金融投资组合优化，与生物力学有限元代理建模无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper addresses financial portfolio optimization, not FEA surrogate modeling, biomechanics, or implant design; no structural mechanics, no uncertainty quantification for physical simulations, and no transferable method for expensive simulation sampling.

summary_zh.method: 将投资组合构建转化为监督学习问题，使用深度集成预测最优权重。
summary_zh.result: 深度集成方法提高了收益中位数和风险调整后性能的稳定性。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance robustness and stability in portfolio optimization by reframing it as a supervised learning task.
summary_en.method: Proposes Decision by Supervised Learning (DSL) with Deep Ensembles to predict optimal portfolio weights using cross-entropy loss.
summary_en.result: Deep ensembles yield higher median returns and more stable risk-adjusted performance across diverse market universes.
summary_en.validation: Validated through comprehensive backtesting on multiple market datasets and neural architectures.

papers.title: Probabilistic Neural Networks (PNNs) with t-Distributed Outputs: Adaptive Prediction Intervals Beyond Gaussian Assumptions
papers.abstract: Traditional neural network regression models provide only point estimates, failing to capture predictive uncertainty. Probabilistic neural networks (PNNs) address this limitation by producing output distributions, enabling the construction of prediction intervals. However, the common assumption of Gaussian output distributions often results in overly wide intervals, particularly in the presence of outliers or deviations from normality. To enhance the adaptability of PNNs, we propose t-Distributed Neural Networks (TDistNNs), which generate t-distributed outputs, parameterized by location, scale, and degrees of freedom. The degrees of freedom parameter allows TDistNNs to model heavy-tailed predictive distributions, improving robustness to non-Gaussian data and enabling more adaptive uncertainty quantification. We incorporate a likelihood based on the t-distribution into neural network training and derive efficient gradient computations for seamless integration into deep learning frameworks. Empirical evaluations on synthetic and real-world data demonstrate that TDistNNs improve the balance between coverage and interval width. Notably, for identical architectures, TDistNNs consistently produce narrower prediction intervals than Gaussian-based PNNs while maintaining proper coverage. This work contributes a flexible framework for uncertainty estimation in neural networks tasked with regression, particularly suited to settings involving complex output distributions.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的t分布输出神经网络可用于不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的预测区间估计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling, lacks any biomechanics or implant design context, and does not address constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统高斯假设导致预测区间过宽，需更灵活的不确定性建模。
summary_zh.method: 提出t分布输出神经网络，用位置、尺度和自由度参数化预测分布。
summary_zh.result: 相比高斯PNN，t分布网络在保持覆盖的同时产生更窄的预测区间。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成和真实数据集上评估区间覆盖与宽度平衡。

summary_en.motivation: Gaussian output assumption in probabilistic neural networks yields overly wide prediction intervals, motivating a more flexible distribution.
summary_en.method: Propose t-Distributed Neural Networks (TDistNNs) that output t-distributions parameterized by location, scale, and degrees of freedom.
summary_en.result: TDistNNs produce narrower prediction intervals than Gaussian PNNs while maintaining proper coverage on synthetic and real-world data.
summary_en.validation: Empirical evaluation on synthetic and real-world regression datasets comparing coverage and interval width.

papers.title: Intraday Battery Dispatch for Hybrid Renewable Energy Assets
papers.abstract: We develop a mathematical model for intraday dispatch of co-located wind-battery energy assets. Focusing on the primary objective of firming grid-side actual production vis-a-vis the preset day-ahead hourly generation targets, we conduct a comprehensive study of the resulting stochastic control problem across different firming formulations and wind generation dynamics. Among others, we provide a closed-form solution in the special case of a quadratic objective and linear dynamics, as well as design a novel adaptation of a Gaussian Process-based Regression Monte Carlo algorithm for our setting. Extensions studied include an asymmetric loss function for peak shaving, capturing the cost of battery cycling, and the role of battery duration. In the applied portion of our work, we calibrate our model to a collection of 140+ wind-battery assets in Texas, benchmarking the economic benefits of firming based on outputs of a realistic unit commitment and economic dispatch solver.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是可再生能源系统中的电池调度问题，与FEA替代建模或植入物设计无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical application; it focuses on energy dispatch optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决风-电池混合资产的日内调度问题，实现电网侧出力与日前目标的匹配。
summary_zh.method: 建立随机控制模型，提出高斯过程回归蒙特卡洛算法求解。
summary_zh.result: 在二次目标线性动力学下给出闭式解，并校准至德州140+资产。
summary_zh.validation: 基于实际资产数据与机组组合求解器进行经济性基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a mathematical model for intraday dispatch of co-located wind-battery assets to firm grid-side production against day-ahead targets.
summary_en.method: A stochastic control problem is formulated and solved with a novel Gaussian Process-based Regression Monte Carlo algorithm, including extensions for peak shaving and battery cycling costs.
summary_en.result: Closed-form solutions are derived for quadratic objectives with linear dynamics, and the model is calibrated to over 140 wind-battery assets in Texas, benchmarking economic benefits.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using real-world asset data and a realistic unit commitment and economic dispatch solver.
